phases.missable_notes: Do the first meditation for trophy 28 (Positive Mental Attitude) during Chapter 1 — on Jason's balcony in the morning, after the Down to Earth mission, when Lucia invites you. It is the only potentially missable trophy in the game, and it is not yet confirmed whether that meditation counts toward the trophy, so do it while you are there. Keep a separate manual save per chapter; there is no mission replay.
phases.summary: Play through the story in order: the opening mission Gone Fishing, Chapters 1 to 4, the named story missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission. Every trophy in this phase unlocks automatically as the story advances. This order is a recommendation built from the official trophy descriptions and the verified guides, not a verified playthrough.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Play the Story

phases.missable_notes: No missable trophies in this phase. PowerPyx states that quest givers return after the story ends, so these questlines can be finished during cleanup if needed. One caution: damnmodz reports the Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is timed and can expire, so do it as soon as it appears. PowerPyx disagrees, saying timed quests do not affect trophies — this trophy is not flagged missable, the note is precautionary only.
phases.summary: Finish the character questlines — Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy, Randy (Wish List of 16 sports cars), Tyrone (Synthetic Labs) and Bret's hunt — and complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only four stranger strands are confirmed so far (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete); the rest are still being confirmed by the guide sites.
phases.title: Phase 2 — Character Questlines & Strangers

phases.missable_notes: Trophy 28 (Positive Mental Attitude) is the only potentially missable trophy in the game: its first meditation in Chapter 1 may no longer be available after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether that meditation counts toward the trophy. Do it during Chapter 1 and keep a separate manual save per chapter.
phases.summary: Work through the activity trophies: 250 stunts, all 9 activity types, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different races won, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, 50 challenges, 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus, maximum Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time, 500 criminal-profile actions, and the 18 meditation spots. Many of these build up naturally while you play the story and travel the map.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Activities & Skills

phases.missable_notes: No missable trophies in this phase. Exploration and collecting can all be done after the story ends.
phases.summary: Sweep the map: complete 3 Collectible Card sets (of 18), WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all of Leonida until the whole map is unfogged, buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. No verified number of areas exists for exploring Leonida, so this guide states none.
phases.title: Phase 4 — Collectibles & Exploration

phases.missable_notes: No missable trophies in this phase. Armored truck robberies only open up through the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, so finish that part of the story first.
phases.summary: The free-roam crime trophies: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, the unscheduled VCIA departure, stealing a tank at the Mile Zero Air Station, the undetected jewelry store robbery, 5 bank vaults, one armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, and the two money grinds — $250,000 laundered through contacts and $100,000 spent across shops. Three one-off free-roam trophies join this phase now that their methods are confirmed: #44 (Apple Martini at the Oceanview Hotel rooftop bar, Ocean Beach, any time), #45 (needs the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — blue Banshee through the south Vice City showroom window), and #50 (after Chapter 1, alone, northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2:00 AM, UFO abduction).
phases.title: Phase 5 — Robberies & Money

phases.missable_notes: No missable trophies in this phase. The platinum is the receipt for the whole run: there is nothing extra to do once the other 54 trophies are earned.
phases.summary: Two trophies (#49 and #51) still have no confirmed unlock method as of 21 November 2026 and should be checked again once the community confirms them; this guide does not invent steps for them. Finish 100% completion (A Long Road), and the platinum (Vice Got a Price!) unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned.
phases.title: Phase 6 — Last Unknowns, 100% & Platinum
